registration.note: Candidate design only. DoE oversight must review and admit the design, freeze the task cohort and decision thresholds, and verify the runner before designed dispatch. No run records exist.

source_subject.classification: restricted-use external reference; not an admitted FOSS dependency
source_subject.license: All Rights Reserved; public viewing and portfolio inspection only; derivative republication requires explicit written permission
source_subject.provenance_note: Cargo.toml repository field points to https://github.com/PNWcoastie/rust-zero-drift rather than the fork URL; resolve provenance before any further admission.

hypothesis.statement: Across authorized, project-owned Rust tasks, independently implemented compile-time guardrails, explicit domain-state modeling, deeper verification and Sans-IO boundaries improve verified invariant satisfaction and reduce escaped regressions versus the repository-native baseline, with acceptable build, review and maintenance cost.
hypothesis.null: The candidate engineering treatments do not improve verified correctness or regression outcomes after task family, difficulty, toolchain and base revision are controlled.
hypothesis.limits: The source repository documents these patterns but has not been independently built or tested in this intake. This campaign evaluates independently authored implementations of the patterns; it does not authorize copying source, skill text or other protected expression.

design.type: 2^4 full-factorial candidate (16 treatment combinations; design proposal only)
design.assignment: Randomize treatment assignment within predeclared task-family and difficulty blocks. Keep the task contract and base revision common across arms. Record exclusions, deviations, failed builds and unexecuted assignments. Use a common cohort and independent evaluation; assess interactions rather than assuming additive gains.
design.unit_of_observation: One authorized Rust task executed under one frozen treatment and configured instance = one EXPERIMENT record.
eligibility: Project-owned or explicitly authorized Rust tasks with stable base SHA, acceptance contract and independent reviewer.
Tasks with reproducible Cargo toolchain, target and CI environment.
Tasks that can be evaluated without copying protected source or skill content from the external reference.
Exclude urgent production incidents, unsafe hardware actions, tasks lacking license/authorization clarity, and tasks without an independently testable outcome.
held_fixed: Same task specification, acceptance criteria, base SHA, target triple and Rust toolchain across compared arms.
Same runner image, hardware class, build profile, dependency cache policy and test timeout policy.
Same independent reviewer and evaluator version across arms.
Same task-family block and difficulty assignment; capture all deviations.
No external repository code, prompts or protected prose copied into the implementation.
design.execution_gate: DoE oversight approves the design, task cohort, toolchain, assignment plan, independent evaluator, sample size, practical-effect threshold, uncertainty method, stopping rule, resource cap, license boundary and automated runner before the first designed dispatch.

outcomes.primary: Verified invariant and requirement satisfaction: independently accepted critical invariants / applicable critical invariants, with all critical requirements passing.
secondary: compile, unit, integration and compile-fail test pass rates
independently reproduced defect count and severity
build/test wall time and resource cost
review rework, steering interventions and integration conflicts
maintenance burden and portability across supported targets
outcomes.failure_attribution: Separate implementation defect, task/specification ambiguity, compiler/toolchain mismatch, test-oracle defect, runner/environment failure, dependency failure and reviewer disagreement. Environment failure is recorded as such, not scored as code failure.

decision_rule.selection_fraction: NOT_ESTABLISHED — DoE oversight sets before execution.
decision_rule.minimum_sample: Standing DoE family dispatch protocol: n=3 is the floor per trigger, dynamically adjusted; after a 2-1 split or spread-in-noise, add exactly one further set. Cap at n=12 per trigger (four pre-registered looks) or the campaign window/budget bound, whichever comes first. A campaign-specific power/precision requirement may be higher, never lower. Hitting the cap without a conclusive result yields INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.significance_and_confidence: Use the standing DoE significance gate; register the practical-effect threshold, uncertainty method and multiplicity handling before dispatch. Apply the family n=3 floor / n=12 cap protocol and record every look.
decision_rule.promotion: Promote an independently implemented pattern only after the primary outcome meets the pre-registered practical threshold, all critical invariants pass, independent review is complete, and regression/security/maintenance constraints pass.
decision_rule.no_selection: Insufficient, contradictory, underpowered or non-reproducible evidence yields no_selection; retain the baseline and record the gap.

generations.generation_zero: Repository-native Rust baseline with exact base SHA, toolchain, target, build settings, test suite and configured-instance stamps.
generations.next_generation: Create new candidate IDs for independently implemented treatment combinations; record parent_candidate_refs and exact source/prompt/tool/config hashes.
generations.culling: Cull only reversible treatment candidates after the pre-registered evidence gate. Preserve all records and lineage. Security, correctness and governance protections remain ineligible for autonomous culling.
generations.monitoring: Compare generations on common task strata; monitor correctness, regression, mutation sensitivity, build cost, portability and maintenance drift.
generations.promotion_authority: DoE oversight, independent reviewer and Operator policy where permissions or protected surfaces are implicated.

instance_stamps.required: EXPERIMENT.schema.json treatment.instance when an agent/provider instance performs the task: provider, model@version, exact system_prompt ref+sha256, tools ref+sha256, role, moniker, context and instance_key.
instance_stamps.missing_fields: Record unknown fields as NOT_ESTABLISHED or null where the schema permits; never fabricate an instance_key.
instance_stamps.record_rule: One append-only EXPERIMENT record per executed observation. Keep raw source/build/test evidence in the approved evidence store and link by URI.

automation.runner: TBD — evaluate reuse of the existing ATES/MVT execution vehicle after verifying Rust/Cargo support; build a bounded repository-native workflow only if the existing runner cannot satisfy the contract.
automation.records: Emit one docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json-conforming record per dispatched observation and an evidence-linked SUMMARY after the cohort closes.
automation.requirement: Automated execution is required for designed results. Manual exploratory runs remain OBSERVATIONAL.

constraints: No designed dispatch, provider invocation, pool mutation or candidate promotion follows from committing this proposal.

The external repository is All Rights Reserved and public-view-only; use it as a reference for capability hypotheses and test independently authored patterns. Obtain written permission before copying or adapting protected code, skill text or other expression.
Campaign remains proposed_not_admitted until DoE oversight approves the design and the automated runner, and the family admission rule is satisfied.
No result, score, build status or test outcome is claimed until an actual run produces evidence.
Keep records append-only; never replace missing measurements with zero.
Keep secrets, private prompts, customer data and restricted source content out of records and artifacts.
